These are matte diffuse painted regions, not embossed microgeometry, no text or tiny decorative patterns.
entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ATTRIBUTE VARIATION REFERENCE SHEET for a modular fantasy game character constructor. EDIT the supplied neutral 2-row by 5-column occupancy master. It is a layout target ONLY, not a style reference. Deliver ONE landscape image containing EXACTLY TEN variants of ONLY THE SINGLE CATEGORY described below, one design inside each of the ten existing cells, read left-to-right across the top row then bottom row. Preserve the fixed 2×5 layout and equal scale; erase all grey guide panels and leave generous empty space between the ten subjects. No panels, borders, grid lines or captions in the result. Every variant has complete uncropped silhouette, consistent camera and comparable size. FRONT ORTHOGRAPHIC view only, no back views, no three-quarter or profile views. These are production-style low-poly 3D asset references: big readable planar facets, primitive-based construction, chunky masses, hard silhouette breaks, few large mesh pieces, low triangle budget. Matte diffuse colour, two to four principal broad colour/material regions, sparse painted highlights, soft even neutral light. Do not imitate any existing game or franchise. Plain neutral dark #1e1e1e background; solid white only if an entire dark subject category would otherwise be unreadable. No cinematic scene, gloss, photorealism, smooth subdivision, tiny surface detail, anime, chibi, painterly concept art, text, labels, numbers, UI or watermark. The ten variants must differ substantially in the requested attribute; unrelated features stay fixed wherever requested. Category and exact variants: Ten CLOTH PATTERN references applied to identical small low-poly headless tunic torso forms, one torso per tile, same two colours deep blue and warm gold for shape comparison: 1 plain two broad colour blocks; 2 vertical halves; 3 four quarters; 4 broad horizontal stripes; 5 large checker squares; 6 broad chevrons; 7 sunburst wedges; 8 sparse large angular rune-like shapes with no real lettering; 9 big diamonds; 10 broad border trim. These are matte diffuse painted regions, not embossed microgeometry, no text or tiny decorative patterns.

entries.label: Палитры материалов
entries.subject: Ten COLOUR PALETTE studies applied to exactly identical low-poly headless armored tunic torso forms with the same relief medallion and belt, one torso per tile; only colours vary. Four broad material regions on each form: cloth, trim, matte metal, leather. Ten palettes: 1 forest green/ivory/brass/brown; 2 burgundy/gold/steel/dark brown; 3 navy/pale gold/steel/black-brown; 4 sand/cream/copper/tan; 5 charcoal/copper/steel/dark brown; 6 plum/pale gold/silver/brown; 7 ivory/cobalt/gold/tan; 8 turquoise/coral/bronze/brown; 9 rust/teal/copper/dark brown; 10 frost blue/ivory/silver/grey leather. No swatch labels, no text, each complete form is one colour study.
